text: TempleOS is God's official temple. Just like Solomon's temple, this is a community focal point where offerings are made and God's oracle is consulted.
God said 640x480 16 color graphics is a covenant like circumcision.
God said His temple must be perfect.
The vision is the same usage model and niche as the Commodore 64 -- a non-networked, simple machine where programming was the goal, not just a means to an end.
It's a kayak, not a Titanic -- it will crash if you do something wrong. You quickly reboot, however.

We do not put any hooks for future changes. "Perfect" means we always act as though it is final, for all time.
Ring-0-only. Everything runs in kernel mode, including user applications.
Simplicity is a goal to keep the line count down, so it's easy to tinker with.
I cherry-pick what it will and won't do, to make it maximally beautiful.

I hope to recreate the dynamic environment that used to exist when the Commodore 64 was around and everyone was creating odd-ball software.
